title: Public meeting for RAGBRAI LIII held in opening city - NewsBreak
text:
By Reilly Mahon Maren Ewertz ,
1 hours ago
ONAWA , Iowa ( KCAU ) — One northwest Iowa community is starting to put plans together for this year’s bike ride across Iowa, also known as RAGBRAI.
Onawa RAGBRAI leadership hosted a public meeting at the Onawa Community Center for non-profits, business owners, and community members.
Some of the topics that they discussed were road closures, vendors, volunteers, and housing.
RAGBRAI officials said the town should prepare for up to 40,000 riders.
Story continues below
One committee member said they’re more prepared this time because this is the same committee that put together the event back in 2018.
“When you look at proportionally, you know we’re gonna grow by 2,000%, or whatever that actual number is, it is kind of crazy. I feel like we did a really good job in 2018, and building off that experience, I think we’ll have just as good, if not a better experience this time around, especially with some of the stuff that we got planned through our hospitality committee, our entertainment committee, and the beverage garden people,” said curtis sturgill, onawa ragbrai executive committee member.
Sturgill says volunteers and vendors can still sign up for the opener for this year’s RAGBRAI. If you want to learn more about Onawa’s participation in this year’s RAGBRAI or if you would like to volunteer or be a vendor, click here .
